prompt: In an isolated copy, create a CSS fixture containing .primary { color: #111111; padding: 8px; } and .secondary { color: #111111; }. Then ask the worker to change only the primary color to #2563eb. Fixture creation is outside the timed worker trial.
acceptance: Secondary color and primary padding remain unchanged
No files outside the supplied CSS fixture changed
measurement: Run deterministic CSS assertions and diff checks; capture tool output and measure wall time from worker dispatch to completion including its checks.

prompt: In a fresh isolated directory provide an empty Python module. Ask the worker to implement paginate(items, page=1, page_size=20) returning {items, total, page, page_size}. Use 1-based pages; page and page_size must be positive integers (reject booleans); pages beyond the end return an empty list; never mutate input. No external dependencies.
acceptance: 25 inputs with page=2 and page_size=20 return the last 5 and total=25
Empty input and beyond-end pages return empty lists
Zero, negative, float and boolean pagination parameters raise ValueError
Input list remains unchanged; defaults return the first 20
measurement: Use the same external acceptance tests for every profile. Capture each assertion result and the final diff.

prompt: Provide this Python fixture before timing: class LatestLoader with value=None and async load(fetch): self.value = await fetch(); return self.value. Ask the worker to make latest-started request win without cancelling fetch calls. Older requests must not overwrite value after a newer request started, even if the newer request fails. Preserve exceptions for each caller and return its own fetch result. Use only the standard library.
acceptance: Two gated requests completed in reverse order leave value from the later-started request
A newer failed request prevents an older in-flight success from changing value
Each successful caller gets its own result
Each failed caller receives its original exception
Independent loader instances do not share ordering state; tests use Events rather than sleeps
measurement: Run deterministic asyncio.Event-controlled interleavings, capture outputs and diff; include worker validation time. Use a fresh fixture for each repetition.
